exampleSentenceArabic: فِي شَهْر يُولْيُو الجَوّ بِيِبْقَى حَرّ جِدّاً فِي القَاهِرَة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: In July, the weather becomes very hot in Cairo.

exampleSentenceArabic: أَغْلَب النَّاس بَتِسَافِر إِسْكِنْدِرِيَّة فِي أَغُسْطُس.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Most people travel to Alexandria in August.

exampleSentenceArabic: السَّنَة الدِّرَاسِيَّة الجَدِيدَة بَتِبْدَأ فِي سِبْتَمْبِر.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The new academic year starts in September.

exampleSentenceArabic: عِنْدَنَا إِجَازَة رَسْمِيَّة فِي السَّادِس مِن أُكْتُوبِر.
exampleSentenceEnglish: We have an official holiday on the Sixth of October.

exampleSentenceArabic: العُرُوض بَتِكُون كِتِيرَة جِدّاً فِي شَهْر نُوفَمْبِر.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Discounts are very plentiful in November.

exampleSentenceArabic: الجَوّ بِيِبْدَأ يِبْرَد جَامِد فِي آخِر دِيسَمْبِر.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The weather starts getting very cold at the end of December.

exampleSentenceArabic: كُلّ فَصْل فِي السَّنَة لِيه مُمَيِّزَاتُه فِي مَصْر.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Every season of the year has its advantages in Egypt.

exampleSentenceArabic: دَرَسْنَا فُصُول السَّنَة الأَرْبَعَة فِي حِصَّة الجُغْرَافْيَا.
exampleSentenceEnglish: We studied the four seasons of the year in geography class.

exampleSentenceArabic: الشِّتَا فِي مَصْر جَمِيل ومِش بَارِد قَوِي.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Winter in Egypt is nice and not too cold.

exampleSentenceArabic: الطَّلَبَة بِتِشْتَغَل فِي إِجَازَة الصِّيف عَلَشَان تِعْتَمِد عَلَى نَفْسَهَا.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Students work during the summer vacation to be independent.

exampleSentenceArabic: الوَرْد بِيِفَتَّح فِي الحَدَايِق فِي فَصْل الرَّبِيع.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Flowers bloom in the gardens in the spring season.

exampleSentenceArabic: الجَوّ فِي الخَرِيف بِيِبْقَى مُعْتَدِل ولَطِيف.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The weather in autumn is moderate and pleasant.

exampleSentenceArabic: الضَّغْط عَلَى الخِدْمَة زَاد لِأَنَّنَا فِي مَوْسِم الحَجّ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Pressure on the service increased because we are in the Hajj season.

exampleSentenceArabic: سَجِّل المَوَاعِيد فِي التِّقْوِيم عَلَى مُوبَايْلَك عَلَشَان مَتِنْسَاش.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Record the appointments in the calendar on your mobile so you don't forget.

exampleSentenceArabic: شَهْر رَمَضَان هُوَّ التَّاسِع فِي التَّارِيخ الهِجْرِي.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The month of Ramadan is the ninth in the Hijri calendar.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَا فَنْدِم التَّارِيخ المَكْتُوب عَلَى الشِّيك مِيلَادِي مِش هِجْرِي.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Sir, the date written on the check is Gregorian, not Hijri.

exampleSentenceArabic: الفَلَّاحِين فِي مَصْر بِيِتَابِعُوا الشُّهُور القِبْطِيَّة لِلزِّرَاعَة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Farmers in Egypt follow the Coptic months for agriculture.

exampleSentenceArabic: مُمْكِن تِأَكِّد لِي تَارِيخ مِيلَاد حَضْرِتَك لِتَأْكِيد الحِسَاب؟
exampleSentenceEnglish: Could you confirm your date of birth to verify the account?

exampleSentenceArabic: التِّرْم التَّانِي بِيِبْقَى أَقْصَر مِن التِّرْم الأَوَّلَانِي.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The second term is usually shorter than the first term.

exampleSentenceArabic: حَضْرِتَك مِيعَاد الجَلْسَة السَّاعَة عَشَرَة الصُّبْح.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Your hearing appointment is at ten in the morning.

exampleSentenceArabic: الاِشْتِرَاك بِيِتْجَدِّد تِلْقَائِيّاً شَهْرِيّاً مِن الكَارْت.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The subscription renews automatically monthly from the card.

exampleSentenceArabic: المَصَارِيف الجَامِعِيَّة بِتِتْدَفِع سَنَوِيّاً قَبْل الدِّرَاسَة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: University tuition is paid annually before classes start.

exampleSentenceArabic: مَكْتَب خِدْمَة العُمَلَاء بِيِسْتَقْبِل مِئَات الشَّكَاوَى يَوْمِيّاً.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The customer service office receives hundreds of complaints daily.

exampleSentenceArabic: أَنَا سَجِّلْت كُورْسَات فِي التِّرْم الصَّيْفِي عَلَشَان أَتَخَرَّج بَدْرِي.
exampleSentenceEnglish: I enrolled in courses during the summer term to graduate early.

exampleSentenceArabic: التَّوْقِيت الشَّتَوِي بِيِبْدَأ فِي آخِر شَهْر أُكْتُوبِر فِي مَصْر.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Winter time (standard time) begins at the end of October in Egypt.

exampleSentenceArabic: مَوَاعِيد العَمَل فِي المَصَالِح الحُكُومِيَّة بَتِتْغَيَّر فِي رَمَضَان.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Working hours in government offices change during Ramadan.

exampleSentenceArabic: أَنَا بَفَضَّل أُذَاكِر الصُّبْح عَلَشَان التَّرْكِيز بِيَكُون أَحْسَن.
exampleSentenceEnglish: I prefer to study in the morning because concentration is better.

exampleSentenceArabic: خِدْمَة العُمَلَا شَغَّالَة وَقْت الضُّهْر عَمَلِيّاً مِن غِير تَوَقُّف.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Customer service is practically operating at noon without interruption.

exampleSentenceArabic: المَكْتَب الحُكُومِي بِيِقْفِل بَعْد العَصْر مُبَاشَرَةً.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The government office closes directly after late afternoon.

exampleSentenceArabic: خَلِّي حَضْرِتَك جَاهِز لِلْمُكَالَمَة قَبْل المَغْرِب.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Please be ready for the call before sunset.

exampleSentenceArabic: المَحَلَّات فِي المِنْطَقَة بِتِفْتَح لِحَدّ بَعْد العِشَا.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Stores in the area stay open until after nightfall.

exampleSentenceArabic: صِحِيت قَبْل الفَجْر عَلَشَان أَلْحَق أَرَاجِع قَبْل اللَّجْنَة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: I woke up before dawn to manage to review before the exam committee.

exampleSentenceArabic: شُرُوق الشَّمْس عَلَى كُورْنِيش النِّيل مَنْظَرُه جَمِيل جِدّاً.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Sunrise over the Nile Corniche is a very beautiful sight.

exampleSentenceArabic: الشَّوَارِع بِتِزْحَم جِدّاً قَبْل غُرُوب الشَّمْس فِي القَاهِرَة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Streets become very crowded before sunset in Cairo.

exampleSentenceArabic: دِي لَيْلَة الاِمْتِحَان، لَازِم تَنَام كُوَيِّس ومَتِتْوَتَّرْش.
exampleSentenceEnglish: This is the night before the exam, you need to sleep well and not get stressed.

exampleSentenceArabic: عَمَلْنَا سَهَرَة حِلْوَة بَعْد مَا خَلَّصْنَا مَشْرُوع التَّخَرُّج.
exampleSentenceEnglish: We had a nice evening get-together after finishing the graduation project.

exampleSentenceArabic: مَفِيش وَقْت كِفَايَة لِحَلّ كُلّ التَّمَارِين فِي الحِصَّة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: There isn't enough time to solve all exercises in class.

exampleSentenceArabic: مُدَّة الاِنْتِظَار عَلَى الخَطّ مَزَادِتْش عَن دَقِيقْتِين.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The waiting time on the line did not exceed two minutes.

exampleSentenceArabic: فَتْرَة الاِمْتِحَانَات مِحْتَاجَة تَنْظِيم لِلْوَقْت ومَجْهُود كِبِير.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The exams period requires time management and great effort.

exampleSentenceArabic: النِّظَام هَيِرْجَع يَشْتَغَل فِي خِلَال سَاعَة يَا فَنْدِم.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The system will be working again within an hour, sir.

exampleSentenceArabic: خَلِّيك مَعَايَا عَلَى الخَطّ دَقِيقَة وَاحْدَة لِمُرَاجَعَة البَيَانَات.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Please stay on the line with me for one minute to review the data.

exampleSentenceArabic: ثَانْيَة وَاحْدَة وهَكُون مَع حَضْرِتَك يَا فَندِم.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Just one second and I will be with you, sir.

exampleSentenceArabic: تَقْدَر تِيجِي المَصْلَحَة الحُكُومِيَّة بَدْرِي قَبْل الزَّحْمَة؟
exampleSentenceEnglish: Can you come to the government agency early before the rush?

exampleSentenceArabic: الطَّالِب وَصَل الكُلِّيَّة مُتَأَخِّر ومَلْحِقْش أَوَّل المَحَاضَرَة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The student arrived at college late and missed the beginning of the lecture.

exampleSentenceArabic: التَّسْجِيل لِلْمَوَادّ هَيِقْفِل الدَّوْر الجَاي.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Registration for courses will close in the coming round.

exampleSentenceArabic: الفَاتُورَة الفَايْتَة مَدْفُوعَة بِالْكَامِل فِي حِسَابَك.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The past invoice is fully paid in your account.

exampleSentenceArabic: المَشْرُوع القَادِم هَيِفْتَتِحُوه رَسْمِيّاً قَرِيب جِدّاً.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The upcoming project will be officially inaugurated very soon.

exampleSentenceArabic: القَرَار المَاضِي اِتْلَغَى بِقَرَار جَدِيد مِن الوِزَارَة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The past decision was revoked by a new decree from the ministry.

exampleSentenceArabic: حَالِيّاً الخِدْمَة غِير مُتَاحَة بِسَبَب أَعْمَال التَّحْدِيث.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Currently, the service is unavailable due to update works.

exampleSentenceArabic: العِيلَة صَيَّفِت فِي مَرْسَى مَطْرُوح بَعْد النَّتِيجَة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The family spent their summer vacation in Marsa Matrouh after the results.

exampleSentenceArabic: الدُّنْيَا شَتَّت فَجْأَة وغَرَّقِت المَيَادِين فِي إِسْكِنْدِرِيَّة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: It rained heavily all of a sudden and flooded the squares in Alexandria.

exampleSentenceArabic: قَضَّى أَكْتَر مِن سَاعْتِين بِيِكْتِب فِي التَّقْرِير.
exampleSentenceEnglish: He spent more than two hours writing the report.

exampleSentenceArabic: فَات وَقْت كِتِير عَلَى تَقْدِيم الطَّلَب ومَجَاش رَدّ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: A lot of time has passed since submitting the application with no response.

exampleSentenceArabic: الوَقْت مَرّ بِسُرْعَة وإِحْنَا بَنِشْتَغَل عَلَى البَحْث.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Time passed quickly while we were working on the research.

exampleSentenceArabic: رَأْس البَرّ مَصْيَف هَادِي ومُنَاسِب لِلْعَائِلات.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Ras El Bar is a quiet summer resort suitable for families.

exampleSentenceArabic: أُسْوَان مِن أَشْهَر المَشَاتِي المَصْرِيَّة فِي العَالَم.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Aswan is one of the most famous Egyptian winter resorts in the world.

exampleSentenceArabic: الحَرّ جُوَّه المُدَرَّج مَخَلِّي الطَّلَبَة مِش قَادْرَة تِرَكِّز.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The heat inside the lecture hall is keeping students from concentrating.

exampleSentenceArabic: البَرْد القَارِس بِيِخَلِّي الصَّحَيَان بَدْرِي صَعْب شِوَيَّة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Freezing cold makes waking up early a bit difficult.

exampleSentenceArabic: حَرَكَة المُرُور اِتْعَطَّلِت بِسَبَب نُزُول المَطَر الغَزِير.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Traffic flow was disrupted due to heavy rainfall.

exampleSentenceArabic: نِزْلِت مَطَرَة شَدِيدَة فَجْأَة عَلَى طَرِيق السُّوَيْس.
exampleSentenceEnglish: A heavy rain shower fell suddenly on the Suez road.

exampleSentenceArabic: إِدَارَة المُرُور قَفَلِت الطَّرِيق الصَّحْرَاوِي بِسَبَب الشَّبُّورَة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Traffic administration closed the desert highway because of dense fog.

exampleSentenceArabic: مِينَاء إِسْكِنْدِرِيَّة بِيِقْفِل حَرَكَة المِلَاحَة أَثْنَاء النَّوَّة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Alexandria port halts navigation traffic during the winter storm.

exampleSentenceArabic: رِيَاح الخَمَاسِين بِتْجِيب تُرَاب كِتِير وبِتْضُرّ النَّاس اللِّي عِنْدَهَا حَسَاسِيَّة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Khamaseen winds bring heavy dust and harm people who have allergies.

exampleSentenceArabic: نِسْبَة الرُّطُوبَة عَالْيَة جِدّاً فِي المُدُن السَّاحِلِيَّة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The humidity level is very high in coastal cities.

exampleSentenceArabic: الجَوّ النَّهَارْدَة هَادِي ومُنَاسِب لِلْقِرَاءَة فِي المَكْتَبَة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The weather today is pleasant and suitable for reading in the library.

exampleSentenceArabic: مَتِقِفْش فِي الشَّمْس الحَامْيَة وإِنْتَ مُسْتَنِّي الأُتُوبِيس.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Do not stand in the burning sun while waiting for the bus.

exampleSentenceArabic: دَار الإِفْتَاء المَصْرِيَّة هَتَسْتَطْلِع هِلَال الشَّهْر الجَدِيد.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The Egyptian Dar al-Ifta will sight the new month's crescent.

exampleSentenceArabic: كُنَّا مَجْمُوعَة مِن الطَّلَبَة بَنِتْفَرَّج عَلَى القَمَر وهُوَّه بَدْر.
exampleSentenceEnglish: We were a group of students watching the moon when it was full.

englishTranslation: Touba (Coptic month known for intense cold)
exampleSentenceArabic: بَرْد طُوبَة مَعْرُوف فِي مَصْر كُلَّهَا إِنُّه أَقْسَى بَرْد.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Touba's cold is known throughout all of Egypt as the harshest chill.

englishTranslation: Amsheer (Coptic month known for fierce winds)
exampleSentenceArabic: أَمْشِير مَشْهُور بِالزَّعَابِيب والتَّقَلُّبَات الجَوِّيَّة الكِتِيرَة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Amsheer is famous for gales and frequent weather fluctuations.

exampleSentenceArabic: فِي بَرَمْهَات بِيَبْدَأ مَوْسِم زِرَاعَة ومَحَاصِيل جَدِيدَة فِي الأَرْيَاف.
exampleSentenceEnglish: In Baramhat, the planting season and new crops begin in rural areas.

englishTranslation: Ba'oona (Coptic month known for sweltering heat)
exampleSentenceArabic: الحَرّ فِي بَؤُونَة بِيِكُون شَدِيد زَيّ مَا بِيِقُول المَثَل.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The heat in Ba'oona is intense, just as the proverb says.

exampleSentenceArabic: مَوَاعِيد العَمَل الحُكُومِيَّة بِتِرْجَع لِطَبِيعِتْهَا فِي شَوَّال.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Government working hours return to normal in Shawwal.

exampleSentenceArabic: الأَسْوَاق المَصْرِيَّة بِتِزْدَحِم بِالبَضَايِع فِي شَعْبَان تَمْهِيداً لِلْمَوْسِم.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Egyptian markets become crowded with goods in Sha'ban ahead of the season.

exampleSentenceArabic: فِي شَهْر رَجَب الجَمْعِيَّات الخَيْرِيَّة بِتَكْتِف جُهُود المُسَاعَدَة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: In the month of Rajab, charitable organizations step up assistance efforts.

exampleSentenceArabic: المَصْرِيِّين كُلُّهُم بِيَحْتَفِلُوا بِشَمّ النَّسِيم فِي الحَدَايِق العَامَّة.
exampleSentenceEnglish: All Egyptians celebrate Sham El-Nessim in public parks.

exampleSentenceArabic: مَا هُوَ لَوْنُ هُوِيَّتِكَ الوَطَنِيَّةِ؟
exampleSentenceEnglish: What is the color of your national identity card?

exampleSentenceArabic: يَسْتَخْدِمُ الطَّالِبُ أَلْوَاناً كَثِيرَةً فِي رَسْمِ الخَرِيطَةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The student uses many colors in drawing the map.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَجِبُ التَّوَقُّفُ عِنْدَمَا يَكُونُ ضَوْءُ المُرُورِ أَحْمَرَ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: You must stop when the traffic light is red.

exampleSentenceArabic: تَحْمِلُ المَرْأَةُ حَقِيبَةً حَمْرَاءَ أَمَامَ المَبْنَى الحُكُومِيِّ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The woman is carrying a red bag in front of the government building.

exampleSentenceArabic: كَتَبَ المُمَثِّلُ المُلَاحَظَاتِ بِقَلَمٍ أَزْرَقَ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The representative wrote the notes with a blue pen.

exampleSentenceArabic: ارْتَدَى الطَّالِبُ سُتْرَةً زَرْقَاءَ فِي حَفْلِ التَّخَرُّجِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The student wore a blue jacket at the graduation ceremony.

exampleSentenceArabic: يُنَبِّهُ الشَّرِيطُ الأَصْفَرُ المُواطِنِينَ إِلَى وُجُودِ أَعْمَالِ صِيَانَةٍ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The yellow tape alerts citizens to ongoing maintenance work.

exampleSentenceArabic: ابْحَثْ عَنِ النَّافِذَةِ الصَّفْرَاءِ فِي أَعْلَى شَاشَةِ النِّظَامِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Look for the yellow window at the top of the system screen.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَرْمُزُ الضَّوْءُ الأَخْضَرُ إِلَى السَّمَاحِ بِالمُرُورِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The green light symbolizes permission to proceed.

exampleSentenceArabic: يُعَانِي المُوَظَّفُ مِنْ أَلَمٍ فِي العُنُقِ بِسَبَبِ الجُلُوسِ الطَّوِيلِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The employee suffers from neck pain due to sitting for long periods.

exampleSentenceArabic: تَعَرَّضَ اللَّاعِبُ لإِصَابَةٍ فِي كَتِفِهِ أَثْنَاءَ المُبَارَاةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The player suffered a shoulder injury during the match.

exampleSentenceArabic: وَضَعَ المُسْعِفُ ضِمَادَةً عَلَى ذِرَاعِ المُصَابِ لِإِيقَافِ النَّزِيفِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The paramedic placed a bandage on the injured person's arm to stop bleeding.

exampleSentenceArabic: غَسْلُ اليَدِ بِالمَاءِ وَالصَّابُونِ يَمْنَعُ انْتِشَارَ العَدْوَى.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Washing the hand with soap and water prevents the spread of infection.

exampleSentenceArabic: أُصِيبَ إِصْبَعُ الكَاتِبِ بِإِرْهَاقٍ نَتِيجَةَ اسْتِخْدَامِ لَوْحَةِ المَفَاتِيحِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The writer's finger became strained as a result of using the keyboard.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَشْعُرُ المَرِيضُ بِضِيقٍ فِي الصَّدْرِ عِنْدَ بَذْلِ مَجْهُودٍ بَدَنِيٍّ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The patient feels chest tightness when exerting physical effort.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَضُخُّ القَلْبُ الدَّمَ إِلَى جَمِيعِ أَنْحَاءِ الجِسْمِ دُونَ تَوَقُّفٍ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The heart pumps blood to all parts of the body without stopping.

exampleSentenceArabic: يُسَبِّبُ التَّدْخِينُ ضَرَرًا بَالِغًا لِأَنْسِجَةِ الرِّئَةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Smoking causes severe damage to lung tissue.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَشْكُو الطِّفْلُ مِنْ مَغْصٍ شَدِيدٍ فِي بَطْنِهِ مُنْذُ الصَّبَاحِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The child has been complaining of severe abdominal cramps since the morning.

exampleSentenceArabic: تُفْرِزُ المَعِدَةُ أَحْمَاضًا تُسَاعِدُ عَلَى هَضْمِ الأَطْعِمَةِ المُخْتَلِفَةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The stomach secretes acids that help digest various foods.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَقُومُ الكَبِدُ بِتَصْفِيَةِ السُّمُومِ وَتَنْظِيمِ مُسْتَوَيَاتِ السُّكَّرِ فِي الدَّمِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The liver filters toxins and regulates blood sugar levels.

exampleSentenceArabic: شُرْبُ المَاءِ بِكَمِّيَّاتٍ كَافِيَةٍ يُحَافِظُ عَلَى كَفَاءَةِ الكُلْيَةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Drinking sufficient amounts of water maintains kidney efficiency.

exampleSentenceArabic: تُسَاعِدُ التَّمَارِينُ الرِّيَاضِيَّةُ فِي تَقْوِيَةِ عَضَلَاتِ الظَّهْرِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Physical exercises help strengthen the back muscles.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَحْمِي العَمُودُ الفِقْرِيُّ الحَبْلَ الشَّوْكِيَّ وَيَمْنَحُ الجِسْمَ دِعَامَتَهُ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The vertebral column protects the spinal cord and provides structural support to the body.

exampleSentenceArabic: وَضَعَ الطَّبِيبُ جَبِيرَةً عَلَى سَاقِ المَرِيضِ بَعْدَ الكَسْرِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The doctor placed a cast on the patient's leg after the fracture.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَشْتَكِي كِبَارُ السِّنِّ غَالِبًا مِنْ خُشُونَةٍ فِي مَفْصِلِ الرُّكْبَةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The elderly often complain of stiffness in the knee joint.

exampleSentenceArabic: ارْتِدَاءُ حِذَاءٍ غَيْرِ مُنَاسِبٍ يُسَبِّبُ أَلَمًا فِي القَدَمِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Wearing unsuitable shoes causes foot pain.

exampleSentenceArabic: الْتَوَى كَاحِلُ اللَّاعِبِ عِنْدَمَا سَقَطَ عَلَى الأَرْضِ فَجْأَةً.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The player's ankle twisted when he fell suddenly onto the ground.

exampleSentenceArabic: يُعَدُّ الكَالْسْيُوم عُنْصُرًا ضَرُورِيًّا لِبِنَاءِ عَظْمٍ قَوِيٍّ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Calcium is considered an essential element for building strong bone.

exampleSentenceArabic: تَحْتَاجُ كُلُّ عَضَلَةٍ إِلَى فَتْرَةِ رَاحَةٍ بَعْدَ التَّدْرِيبِ الشَّاقِّ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Every muscle requires a rest period after strenuous training.

exampleSentenceArabic: يُسَهِّلُ المَفْصِلُ حَرَكَةَ العِظَامِ وَالْتِقَاءَهَا بِسَلَاسَةٍ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The joint facilitates the movement and smooth connection of bones.

exampleSentenceArabic: تَبَرَّعَ المُواطِنُونَ بِالدَّمِ لِمُسَاعَدَةِ ضَحَايَا الحَادِثِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Citizens donated blood to help the accident victims.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَنْقُلُ الوَرِيدُ الدَّمَ غَيْرَ المُؤَكْسَجِ مِنَ الأَنْسِجَةِ إِلَى القَلْبِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The vein carries deoxygenated blood from the tissues to the heart.

exampleSentenceArabic: انْسِدَادُ الشِّرْيَانِ التَّاجِيِّ يُؤَدِّي إِلَى مَشَاكِلَ صِحِّيَّةٍ خَطِيرَةٍ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Blockage of the coronary artery leads to serious health issues.

exampleSentenceArabic: يُمَثِّلُ الجِلْدُ خَطَّ الدِّفَاعِ الأَوَّلَ لِحِمَايَةِ الجِسْمِ مِنَ المِيكْرُوبَاتِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The skin represents the first line of defense protecting the body from microbes.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَتَحَكَّمُ الدِّمَاغُ فِي جَمِيعِ الوَظَائِفِ الحَيَوِيَّةِ وَالتَّفْكِيرِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The brain controls all vital functions and thinking.

exampleSentenceArabic: تَحْمِي الجُمْجُمَةُ الدِّمَاغَ مِنْ أَيِّ صَدَمَاتٍ خَارِجِيَّةٍ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The skull protects the brain from any external shocks.

exampleSentenceArabic: أُصِيبَ الطَّالِبُ بِالْتِهَابٍ حَادٍّ فِي الحَلْقِ جَعَلَهُ يَتَغَيَّبُ عَنِ الدَّرْسِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The student contracted a severe throat infection that caused him to miss the lesson.

exampleSentenceArabic: تَقُومُ الأَمْعَاءُ بِامْتِصَاصِ العَنَاصِرِ الغِذَائِيَّةِ بَعْدَ هَضْمِهَا.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The intestines absorb nutrients after they are digested.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَرْتَعِشُ جَفْنُ العَيْنِ أَحْيَانًا نَتِيجَةَ الإِرْهَاقِ وَالسَّهَرِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The eyelid sometimes twitches as a result of exhaustion and staying up late.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَدُلُّ تَغَيُّرُ لَوْنِ الظُّفْرِ عَلَى بَعْضِ المَشَاكِلِ الصِّحِّيَّةِ فِي الجِسْمِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: A change in nail color indicates some health problems in the body.

exampleSentenceArabic: تَشَقَّقَتِ الشَّفَةُ السُّفْلَى بِسَبَبِ الجَفَافِ وَالبَرْدِ القَارِسِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The lower lip cracked due to dryness and extreme cold.

exampleSentenceArabic: احْمَرَّ خَدُّ الوَلَدِ مِنَ الخَجَلِ أَمَامَ زُمَلَائِهِ فِي الصَّفِّ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The boy's cheek flushed red with shyness before his classmates in class.

exampleSentenceArabic: تَصَبَّبَ العَرَقُ مِنْ جَبِينِهِ أَثْنَاءَ أَدَاءِ العَمَلِ الشَّاقِّ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Sweat poured from his forehead during the execution of the arduous work.

exampleSentenceArabic: اصْطَدَمَ مِرْفَقُهُ بِحَافَّةِ الطَّاوِلَةِ فَشَعَرَ بِأَلَمٍ مُفَاجِئٍ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: His elbow hit the edge of the table and he felt sudden pain.

exampleSentenceArabic: يُشَكِّلُ القَفَصُ الصَّدْرِيُّ دِرْعًا وَاقِيًا لِلْقَلْبِ وَالرِّئَتَيْنِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The rib cage forms a protective shield for the heart and lungs.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَنْقُلُ الحَبْلُ الشَّوْكِيُّ الإِشَارَاتِ العَصَبِيَّةَ بَيْنَ الدِّمَاغِ وَبَقِيَّةِ الأَعْضَاءِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The spinal cord transmits nerve impulses between the brain and the rest of the organs.

exampleSentenceArabic: نَبَضَ قَلْبُهُ بِسُرْعَةٍ عَالِيَةٍ عِنْدَمَا سَمِعَ خَبَرَ الحَادِثِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: His heart beat rapidly when he heard the news of the accident.

exampleSentenceArabic: تَنَفَّسَ الرَّجُلُ بِعُمْقٍ لِيَسْتَعِيدَ هُدُوءَهُ وَتَرْكِيزَهُ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The man breathed deeply to regain his composure and focus.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَتَطَلَّبُ هَذَا النَّشَاطُ بِنَاءً عَضَلِيًّا قَوِيًّا لِتَفَادِي الإِرْهَاقِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: This activity requires strong muscular build to avoid fatigue.

exampleSentenceArabic: تَسْعَى الصِّحَّةُ العَامَّةُ إِلَى تَعْزِيزِ النَّشَاطِ الجَسَدِيِّ لَدَى جَمِيعِ الفِئَاتِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: Public health seeks to promote physical activity among all groups.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَقَعُ المَنْزِلُ قُرْبَ المَدْرَسَةِ الوَطَنِيَّةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The house is located near the national school.

exampleSentenceArabic: اسْتَأْجَرَ الطَّالِبُ شَقَّةً صَغِيرَةً قُرْبَ الجَامِعَةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The student rented a small apartment near the university.

exampleSentenceArabic: تَحْتَوِي هَذِهِ الشَّقَّةُ عَلَى ثَلَاثِ غُرَفٍ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: This apartment contains three rooms.

exampleSentenceArabic: غُرْفَةُ النَّوْمِ هَادِئَةٌ وَمُطِلَّةٌ عَلَى الحَدِيقَةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The bedroom is quiet and overlooks the garden.

exampleSentenceArabic: تَجْتَمِعُ الأُسْرَةُ كُلَّ مَسَاءٍ فِي غُرْفَةِ المَعِيشَةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The family gathers every evening in the living room.

exampleSentenceArabic: خَصَّصَ المَالِكُ غُرْفَةَ الضُّيُوفِ لِاسْتِقْبَالِ الزَّائِرِينَ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The owner designated the guest room for welcoming visitors.

exampleSentenceArabic: تَمَّ تَجْهِيزُ المَطْبَخِ بِأَحْدَثِ الأَجْهِزَةِ الكَهْرَبَائِيَّةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The kitchen was equipped with the latest electrical appliances.

exampleSentenceArabic: يُوجَدُ حَمَّامٌ إِضَافِيٌّ فِي الطَّابِقِ العُلْوِيِّ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: There is an additional bathroom on the upper floor.

exampleSentenceArabic: أَجْلِسُ فِي الشُّرْفَةِ لِاحْتِسَاءِ القَهْوَةِ صَبَاحًا.
exampleSentenceEnglish: I sit on the balcony to drink coffee in the morning.

exampleSentenceArabic: تُحِيطُ حَدِيقَةٌ جَمِيلَةٌ بِالمَبْنَى السَّكَنِيِّ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: A beautiful garden surrounds the residential building.

exampleSentenceArabic: يُمْكِنُ الوُصُولُ إِلَى سَطْحِ البِنَايَةِ عَبْرَ الدَّرَجِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The roof of the building can be reached via the stairs.

exampleSentenceArabic: المَمَرُّ يُؤَدِّي إِلَى المَكَاتِبِ الإِدَارِيَّةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The hallway leads to the administrative offices.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَقَعُ مَدْخَلُ العِمَارَةِ فِي الشَّارِعِ الرَّئِيسِيِّ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The entrance of the building is located on the main street.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَجِبُ إِغْلَاقُ البَابِ الرَّئِيسِيِّ لَيْلًا.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The main door must be closed at night.

exampleSentenceArabic: فَتَحَ النَّافِذَةَ لِتَجْدِيدِ الهَوَاءِ فِي القَاعَةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: He opened the window to refresh the air in the room.

exampleSentenceArabic: عَلَّقَ الطَّالِبُ خَرِيطَةً عَلَى جِدَارِ غُرْفَتِهِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The student hung a map on the wall of his room.

exampleSentenceArabic: أَرْضِيَّةُ القَاعَةِ مَصْنُوعَةٌ مِنَ الخَشَبِ الصَّلْبِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The room floor is made of solid wood.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَحْتَاجُ سَقْفُ الغُرْفَةِ إِلَى إِصْلَاحٍ عَاجِلٍ بِسَبَبِ التَّسَرُّبِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The room's ceiling requires urgent repair due to the leak.

exampleSentenceArabic: صَعِدَ الرَّجُلُ الدَّرَجَ إِلَى الطَّابِقِ الثَّانِي.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The man climbed the stairs to the second floor.

exampleSentenceArabic: أَبْلَغَ السَّاكِنُ عَنْ عُطْلٍ فِي مِصْعَدِ البِنَايَةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The resident reported a malfunction in the building's elevator.

exampleSentenceArabic: يُسْتَخْدَمُ القَبْوُ لِتَخْزِينِ الأَثَاثِ القَدِيمِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The basement is used for storing old furniture.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَتَّسِعُ المِرْآبُ لِسَيَّارَتَيْنِ كَبِيرَتَيْنِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The garage accommodates two large cars.

exampleSentenceArabic: أَسْدَلَ السِّتَارَةَ لِحَجْبِ ضَوْءِ الشَّمْسِ القَوِيِّ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: He drew the curtain to block the strong sunlight.

exampleSentenceArabic: وَضَعَتِ المَرْأَةُ سَجَّادَةً حَمْرَاءَ فِي المَدْخَلِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The woman placed a red carpet in the entrance.

exampleSentenceArabic: تَتَّسِعُ الأَرِيكَةُ لِثَلَاثَةِ أَشْخَاصٍ بِرَاحَةٍ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The sofa comfortably seats three people.

exampleSentenceArabic: اشْتَرَى الطَّالِبُ سَرِيرًا خَشَبِيًّا لِغُرْفَتِهِ الجَدِيدَةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The student bought a wooden bed for his new room.

exampleSentenceArabic: رَتَّبَ مَلَابِسَهُ دَاخِلَ الخِزَانَةِ الكَبِيرَةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: He arranged his clothes inside the large wardrobe.

exampleSentenceArabic: وَضَعَ الحَاسُوبَ عَلَى طَاوِلَةِ الدِّرَاسَةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: He placed the computer on the study table.

exampleSentenceArabic: جَلَسَ البَاحِثُ عَلَى كُرْسِيٍّ مُرِيحٍ لِلْقِرَاءَةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The researcher sat on a comfortable chair to read.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَحْتَاجُ مِصْبَاحُ المَكْتَبِ إِلَى تَغْيِيرِ المِصْبَاحِ الكَهْرَبَائِيِّ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The desk lamp needs a lightbulb replacement.

exampleSentenceArabic: تَحْفَظُ الثَّلَّاجَةُ الأَطْعِمَةَ طَازَجَةً لِعِدَّةِ أَيَّامٍ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The refrigerator keeps foods fresh for several days.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَعْمَلُ الفُرْنُ بِالغَازِ الطَّبِيعِيِّ بِشَكْلٍ فَعَّالٍ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The oven operates efficiently on natural gas.

exampleSentenceArabic: قَدَّمَ المُسْتَأْجِرُ طَلَبًا لِصِيَانَةِ غَسَّالَةِ المَلَابِسِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The tenant submitted a request for washing machine maintenance.

exampleSentenceArabic: انْسَدَّتْ مَغْسَلَةُ الحَمَّامِ بِسَبَبِ تَرَاكُمِ الأَوْسَاخِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The bathroom sink became clogged due to dirt accumulation.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَتَمَيَّزُ حَوْضُ الاسْتِحْمَامِ بِحَجْمِهِ الوَاسِعِ وَتَصْمِيمِهِ العَصْرِيِّ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The bathtub is distinguished by its spacious size and modern design.

exampleSentenceArabic: تَمَّ تَرْكِيبُ مِرْآةٍ كَبِيرَةٍ فَوْقَ المَغْسَلَةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: A large mirror was installed above the washbasin.

exampleSentenceArabic: يَقْضِي الطَّالِبُ سَاعَاتٍ طَوِيلَةً أَمَامَ مَكْتَبِهِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The student spends long hours in front of his desk.

exampleSentenceArabic: رَتَّبَ أَمِينُ المَكْتَبَةِ المَرَاجِعَ عَلَى الرَّفِّ الخَشَبِيِّ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: The librarian organized the references on the wooden shelf.

exampleSentenceArabic: اشْتَرَى وِسَادَةً طِبِّيَّةً لِتَخْفِيفِ أَلَمِ الرَّقَبَةِ.
exampleSentenceEnglish: He bought an orthopedic pillow to relieve neck pain.
